title: Your Eyes Are Burning — Here's Why
source: Computer Vision Syndrome: blink rate drops ~60% during screen focus; 7 in 10 screen workers affected (AOA patient education summaries). 20-20-20 rule (AOA).

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.vo: Seven in ten screen workers get Computer Vision Syndrome. Here's what it sounds like in real life.

beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.vo: Uncle, my eyes are burning! Four hours of coding and I can barely read the screen.

beats.speaker: VIKRAM
beats.vo: That is your eyes drying out, beta. You blink sixty percent less when you stare at screens.

beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.vo: Sixty percent less? So the moisture just evaporates?

beats.speaker: VIKRAM
beats.vo: Exactly. Dryness, strain, headaches, blurred vision. Follow the twenty rule. Every twenty minutes, look twenty feet away for twenty seconds.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.vo: Education only, not medical advice. Follow for the science behind your screen habits.
